objective: Close the repository-side mutation-by-request hole in the external information bridge and freeze the exact six-kind bridge request interface while preserving external-process internal effects as an explicit C1 residual.

discovered_counterexample.prior_behavior: _bridge_aware_urlopen classified all urlopen requests as information EXACT_FETCH while forwarding method and optional body, allowing a non-GET/body-bearing request to cross an information-only bridge.
discovered_counterexample.repair: Reject method != GET or non-None body before _external_tool_bridge or raw urllib transport.
discovered_counterexample.causal_effect: A mutating HTTP request can no longer be smuggled through the urlopen information path.
